title: Senior Technical Customer Engineer
description:
LeadSimple helps property management companies make their operations simple, scalable, and consistent. We are a remote-first team that moves quickly, cares deeply about quality, and stays close to our customers.
We are redesigning how customer-reported problems move from first report to verified fix. AI will increasingly perform first-pass investigation, reproduce issues, and propose code changes. The hardest cases still require distinctly human judgment: asking the right follow-up questions, earning customer trust, determining whether a report is a defect, configuration issue, or product request, and ensuring the right resolution happens on time.
We are looking for a Senior Technical Customer Engineer to own that boundary. You will lead technical customer conversations, investigate issues across logs, data, APIs, and application code, review AI-generated fixes, coordinate Engineering response against tiered SLAs, and turn recurring escalations into systemic improvements.
What this role is
A senior individual-contributor role at the intersection of customers, Support, Product, and Engineering. It is not a traditional Tier 1 support position and it is not a conventional feature-development role.
What you will own

• Lead discovery and diagnostic calls for escalated customer issues, often alongside Customer Success or Support.

• Turn incomplete or ambiguous reports into clear reproduction steps, timelines, impact statements, and technical evidence.

• Investigate issues using application logs, SQL, APIs, browser tools, cloud and observability platforms, and source code.

• Classify each issue accurately: software defect, customer configuration, data or integration problem, education gap, feature request, or product decision.

• Review AI-generated analyses and pull requests for root-cause alignment, correctness, regression risk, tests, maintainability, and customer impact.

• Improve or ship bounded fixes when appropriate, while coordinating broader changes with the Engineering team.

• Own escalated issues from intake through validated resolution, including clear internal and customer-facing status updates.

• Maintain the operational SLA tracker across customer tier and issue severity, surface breach risk early, and ensure the responsible teams are keeping pace.

• Apply priority and commercial-promise rules defined with Engineering, Product, and Customer leadership; bring evidence when those policies need adjustment.

• Identify recurring failure patterns and improve runbooks, knowledge, diagnostic tooling, tests, support enablement, and AI investigation workflows.

• Use time between escalations to reduce repeat defects and increase the share of issues that can be resolved safely without Engineering intervention.

What success looks like

• Customers feel heard and leave technical calls with credible next steps.

• Engineers receive reproducible, evidence-rich issues rather than vague escalations.

• SLA risks are visible before they become breaches.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is hiring a Senior Recruiter to lead critical searches across our G&A functions.

These teams shape how Ramp grows, protects the business, and maintains a high bar as we scale. You will own searches from initial scoping through close, partnering directly with leaders across Recruiting, Risk, and other G&A functions. You will be expected to develop real fluency in each area you support, translate ambiguous business needs into clear hiring strategies, and bring an independent point of view on talent.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally strong at research, assessment, stakeholder partnership, and closing. You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating sensitive searches, and creating structure without slowing the business down.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own full-cycle recruiting across Recruiting, Risk, and other G&A functions, from intake and market mapping through offer and close.

- Partner with hiring leaders to define the hiring thesis, calibrate the bar, and translate ambiguous needs into clear search strategies and interview plans.

- Build proactive pipelines through market research, targeted sourcing, referrals, and thoughtful engagement with passive candidates.

- Advise leaders using market intelligence, recruiting data, and candidate feedback to challenge assumptions and improve hiring decisions.

- Run disciplined, high-velocity processes while delivering a personal candidate experience and leading thoughtful closing strategies for competitive hires.

 

WHAT YOU NEED

- 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including significant ownership of G&A, corporate, or specialized business-function searches.

- Experience recruiting for functions such as Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, People, or Recruiting.

- A track record of independently leading complex or senior-level searches from initial scoping through accepted offer.

- Strong talent judgment and research instincts. You can map a market, identify meaningful signals, and explain why someone is likely to excel at Ramp.

- The credibility to advise senior leaders, challenge requirements, and influence hiring decisions through clear communication, market insight, and data.

- Strong execution and closing skills, including comfort with AI-enabled recruiting workflows, ATS and funnel discipline, competing offers, and sensitive searches.

 

NICE-TO-HAVE

- Experience supporting multiple G&A functions in a high-growth, technology, or similarly fast-moving company.

- Familiarity with the talent landscape across fintech, financial services, SaaS, or other regulated industries.

- Experience improving interview architecture, scorecards, market maps, or recruiting processes where structure was limited or still being built.

- Experience developing AI-enabled recruiting workflows that were adopted beyond your own individual searches.
